            THE INTEGRITY LOOP ARCHITECTURE
          

          
Closing the Loop on Autonomous Swarms

          

            Stateless LLMs suffer from prompt amnesia and unverified execution drift. The Integrity Protocol enforces real-time intent constraints and cryptographic identity. Super-Cortex provides the missing link: an immutable, managed cognitive ledger that anchors every verified event, feeds back grounded recall, and closes the evolutionary loop.

            hub
            3D KNOWLEDGE TOPOLOGY
          

          
Hierarchical Graph Folding & Subgraph Clustering

          

            In multi-agent swarms with thousands of memories, raw graphs overwhelm human perception and GPU pipelines. Super-Cortex introduces mathematically grounded hierarchical graph contraction: fold any scope into a Subgraph Super-Node with zero frame drops, weighted meta-edge bundling, and fluid 350ms blossom physics.
          

        

        

          

            

              compress
              Scope Subgraph Folding
            

            

              Collapse 100+ member nodes into a single glowing orbital hub. Suppresses intra-scope clutter and achieves up to 96% fewer active edge tubes, guaranteeing a rock-solid 60 FPS viewport.
            

            
Adaptive threshold (≥250 nodes) auto-folds on load.

          

          

            

              alt_route
              Dynamic Meta-Edge Bundling
            

            

              Cross-scope relations dynamically redirect and collapse into thick, glowing Meta-Edges connecting scope hubs, with tube radius and arrow scale logarithmically weighted by connection density.
            

            
Reroutes parallel connections in O(E) per frame.

          

          

            

              tune
              Custom Scope & Layout Studio
            

            

              Create custom nodes with arbitrary scopes, configurable JSON properties, and bidirectional relationships. Sliders for padding, spread, elevation, and repulsion ensure zero node collision.
            

            
O(N) 3D spatial voxel hash collision solver.

          

        

      


      
      

        

          

            model_training
            ZERO ADDED TOKEN SURCHARGES
          

          
Your agent already has a model. Let it write the memories.

          

            Learning memories from raw notes needs an LLM. Instead of paying a proprietary middleman for tokens, the agent session you are already running
            does the extraction: it claims pending documents, reads them with its own model, and submits what it learned with verbatim quote verification.
          

        

        

          
    
            
  1. 1 · Claim. The engine leases up to 10 pending documents to your session and hands it the extractor prompt.
    2. 
            
  2. 2 · Extract. Your model writes short memories, each with a quote copied from its document.
    3. 
            
  3. 3 · Verify. The engine keeps a memory only if its quote is really in the document, rejects anything that looks like a secret, merges duplicates and supersedes stale facts.
    4. 
            
  4. Every memory records which model wrote it (session:<model>). Namespaces set to dreaming: off are never handed to any model.
    5. 
          

          

            

              From any MCP agent
              
memory_extraction_claim
  → read prompt, extract
memory_extraction_submit
  claim_id, documents

            

            

              From the command line
              
super-cortex extract run \
  --with "claude -p"

# or codex exec, gemini -p, ...
